findings.title: Her face core goes under a control on a tall phone (360x800) and on a tablet held upright (768x1024)
findings.detail: The rule is that her face core stays clear of every control at every size. The builder's lobby-illustrations sizes (844x390, 1280x720, 667x375, 932x430, 1024x768, 1180x820, 390x844) all pass, but two common portrait sizes fail. At 360x800 the top bar wraps its wallets to a third row and the gems '+' (gems-plus, 112,124 24x24) lands on her eye line for 5 of the full illustrations (hikari-rampart, sango-harbour, azami-scene, kinu-scene, marumi-scene). At 768x1024 the news chip's pager (lobby-news-next, 284,84 60x56) sits over her left eye for hikari-rampart and marumi-scene. In each case placeFull returns clearCtl false (no room to pan: the picture is exactly as tall as the screen, and the 8 % sideways pan is not enough), so the fallback keeps her as painted and the control covers her face itself. Portrait is a supported fallback ('Continue in portrait' on touch; a desktop window shaped 768x1024 never sees the rotate prompt). Fix ideas: in portrait let the sideways search pan further (the 1835 px wide picture has 800+ px of room), keep the wallets on two rows at 360 wide, or move the chip below her face in portrait; then add 360x800 and 768x1024 to the e2e's default sizes.

findings.title: A machine-specific node_modules symlink is committed (65a6673) and deletes an installed node_modules on checkout or merge
findings.detail: The WIP commit 65a6673 added a tracked symlink `node_modules -> /home/user/sakura-game/node_modules` (mode 120000). The .gitignore rule `node_modules/` (trailing slash) only ignores directories, so the link is tracked and would ship to main with this branch. Git treats the ignored files of an existing node_modules directory as expendable: checking this branch out (or merging it) in a checkout with dependencies installed silently deletes that node_modules and puts the absolute link in its place; in /home/user/sakura-game itself the link would then point to itself. On a machine without symlink support (core.symlinks=false, common on Windows) it becomes a plain text file named node_modules. npm ci on Linux removes it ('Removing non-directory'), leaving the tree dirty (typechange) after every install. Fix: `git rm --cached node_modules` on the branch (and optionally make the ignore rule `node_modules` without the slash).
findings.evidence: git ls-tree 7b18b60 node_modules -> '120000 blob f4f4700e... node_modules'; git log -- node_modules -> 65a6673 'wip: no-zoom placement and title preload (in progress)'; git diff --stat origin/feature/ui-v2...HEAD lists 'node_modules | 1 +'. Scratch repo repro: main with an installed node_modules/vite/index.js, `git checkout sym` -> node_modules is now a link to /some/abs/node_modules and node_modules/vite is gone. Scratch npm ci repro: 'npm warn reify Removing non-directory .../node_modules'.

findings.title: After the Notice or the Background picker (opened from the menu) closes, the focus drops to <body>
findings.detail: Rows and head tools close the sheet with close() (not 'dismiss'), so the focus is not given back to top-menu; when the Notice or the Background picker then closes (Esc or its button), the focus is on BODY and the next Tab restarts at the top of the page. Give the focus back to top-menu when a modal opened from the sheet closes.
